title: Same Lesson, Different Story: Cross-Lingual Reconstruction of Cultural Narratives in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating narratives using culturally grounded proverbs across 15 languages in monolingual and cross-lingual settings, and analyzing whether models preserve cultural meaning or alter narrative realization, entities, and framing.

Comparing semantic homogeneity and narrative shifts in LLM-generated stories when models are prompted with translated proverbs (cross-lingual) versus the original source language proverbs (monolingual).

Calculating latent semantic power scores for narrative entities by comparing them to anchor embeddings for dominance and subordination (weakness) to measure how cross-lingual conditioning redistributes social power and agency.
